events.title: Swiss Market Ends Higher For 2nd Straight Day
events.description: After opening on a firm note, Swiss stocks stayed firm in positive territory through the trading session on Monday, in line with markets across Europe, as slightly easing geopolitical tensions lifted investor sentiment.

events.title: European Markets Close On Firm Note Amid Easing Geopolitical Tensions
events.description: European markets closed on a firm note on Monday, extending gains from previous session as lower bond yields and hopes of Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" helped underpin sentiment.

events.title: Dollar Rises Amidst Inflation Focus, Haven Demand
events.description: The U.S. Dollar rallied further during the week ended October 9 as markets digested the hawkish minutes from the recent FOMC that revealed a Fed focused on inflation combat.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises On Fed Rate Hike Bets
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday, as trader are pricing out the likelihood of a rate hike at the Fed meeting in late October, although expectations for a 25-basis-point increase in December are still firmly on the table.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Up Firmly In Positive Territory As Bank Stocks Post Strong Gains
events.description: After opening modestly higher, the U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 remained firmly up in positive territory a little past noon on Monday, extending previous session's upmove thanks to lower bond yields and somewhat stable oil prices.

events.title: CAC 40 Modestly Higher As Stocks Turn In Mixed Performance
events.description:
French stocks turned in a mixed performance on Monday with investors assessing the Middle East situation and tracking oil prices and bond yields movements. 

Oil's recovery from the lower levels limited market's upside.

events.title: Indian Shares End Notably Lower As FII Selling Continues
events.description: Indian shares gave up early gains to end notably lower on Monday as persistent foreign selling, elevated crude oil prices and rising domestic bond yields offset investor optimism stemming from the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) weekend measures to support the rupee and manage liquidity.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower Amid Gulf Unrest
events.description: Gold prices edged lower on Monday as investors monitored the situation in oil markets and looked forward to the release of U.S. consumer and producer price inflation data due this week, which could impact expectations for the Federal Reserve's next monetary policy meeting later this month.

events.title: German Stocks Extending Recent Gains
events.description: German stocks gained notable ground in positive territory Monday morning, extending gains from the previous session, amid easing geopolitical tensions after U.S. President Donald Trump's comments that there won't be any military action against Iran before the midterm elections in the U.S.

events.title: Oil Prices Rise In Choppy Trade
events.description: Oil prices traded higher on Monday, recouping early losses in the wake of fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia's aviation infrastructure by Iran-backed Houthi militants and a drone strike on a tanker near the Sohar anchorage off Oman.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher As Bond Yields Fall
events.description: European stocks traded higher on Monday, after having recovered from four-month lows in the previous session on U.S. President Trump's remarks dismissing speculation of pre-midterm military action against Iran.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed In Cautious Trade
events.description: Asian stocks turned in a mixed performance on Monday, with South Korean markets falling sharply due to worsening investor sentiment in the semiconductor sector on growing concerns over the AI industry in the U.S.
